unlisted_practices: Using retrieval-augmented generation with curated domain knowledge bases to generate pediatric speech-language pathology educational vignettes
Automated multi-dimensional rubric quality assessment of generated educational cases
Using open-source locally deployable LLMs for privacy-preserving institutional deployment

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a proof-of-concept RAG-based pipeline across multiple LLMs to generate pediatric speech-language pathology educational vignettes, evaluated via automated scoring metrics without testing a specific deployment safeguard comparative condition.
